name: Mariners Cave
reason: Named stop on Vava'u day tours by Wikivoyage and Tonga Tourism; swim-in sea cave through an underwater tunnel is a distinct draw (rule 1, 2).
objection: Reached only by boat and an underwater swim; tours bundle it with Swallows Cave.

name: Swallows Cave
reason: Two counted sources; sea cave and snorkelling stop on boat tours, a staple site.
objection: Visit may be only a short swim and is bundled in a tour; near-neighbour of Mariners Cave.

name: Swallows Rock
reason: Single dive-site mention, probably the same dive as Swallows Cave: near-duplicate (rule 3), no coordinates.
objection: If it is a separate dive site it is a genuine Tonga Tourism highlight.

name: Mt Talau National Park
reason: Wikivoyage See entry: national park with a short walk and harbour views, 2 km from Neiafu.
objection: One source and a roughly 1 km walk; may only rate review.

name: Mt Talau Lookout
reason: Summit of the Mt Talau walk, part of the larger park spot (rule 3).
objection: Own Wikivoyage listing and the view is the walk's payoff.

name: 'Ene'io Botanical Garden
reason: Two counted sources; Tonga's only botanical garden with visitors' centre (rule 1, 2).
objection: Remote east coast, small, opening not confirmed.

name: St Joseph's Cathedral, Neiafu
reason: Wikivoyage names only a harbour landmark; nothing to see or do inside is named (church rule).
objection: Prominent landmark and the entry is a See listing.

name: Utakalongalu Market
reason: Neiafu market with fruit and fish on Wikivoyage Buy list; days not stated, so cannot confirm daily trade (rule 4). Case for: town market is a cultural stop. Against: one source, may be weekly/daily-morning only.
objection: Only one source; could be a plain produce market.

name: Hunga Island
reason: Wikivoyage: main concentration of humpbacks, sheltered bays, 35 min from Neiafu; island is the place the whale trips go to.
objection: Draw is seasonal whales, and Wikivoyage is the only source.

name: Pangaimotu
reason: Second-largest island with beaches, coves and snorkelling, named in Wikivoyage; second-tier beach/island stop.
objection: Single source, broad area rather than a point.

name: Avai'o'vuna Swamp
reason: Small wetland with no facilities or coordinates; passing mention (rule 2).
objection: Named in Wikivoyage.

name: Tapana Island
reason: Resort/restaurant island; accommodation and a restaurant, not an attraction (rule 2).
objection: Ten-minute boat trip and a known Spanish restaurant.

name: Mala Island
reason: Resort island whose entry is accommodation and a Sunday pig roast (event-like) (rule 2, 4).
objection: Day visitors can go for the beach.

name: Mounu Island
reason: Resort restaurant and bar only (rule 2).
objection: Beach islet in a scenic anchorage.

name: Utungake Island
reason: Appears only as beach fale resort accommodation (rule 2).
objection: Island with resorts that welcome visitors.

name: Utula'aina Point Lookout
reason: Wikivoyage names the walk past Holonga to the lookout and down to Secret Beach; one source, half-day walk. Case for: a coastal walk with views. Against: minimal info, part of one walk with Secret Beach.
objection: Single source, no verified track, near-duplicate with Secret Beach.

name: Secret Beach
reason: Part of the same walk as Utula'aina lookout, no coordinates, one source (rule 3).
objection: Named beach, a typical second-tier stop.

name: Toafa Church
reason: Wikivoyage names it as a viewing point over Hunga cliffs; church judged for view only. Case for: guide singles out the view. Against: local church, one source, view only.
objection: Looks like a parish church on a point.

name: Vava'u Pearl Centre
reason: Two Tonga Tourism pages name it as the place to learn about mabe pearls; Case for: displays and a visitor draw. Against: basically a shop, 0 views.
objection: Likely a retail shop with a display.

name: Ava Pulepulekai
reason: Tonga Tourism highlight: 11 km fjord-like channel; visited by boat. Case for: official highlight, distinct scenery. Against: one source, a waterway rather than a stop, no coordinates.
objection: Feature or area, not a point to visit.

name: Port of Refuge Harbour
reason: Setting of Neiafu rather than a distinct stop; the harbour is a view from town and anchorage (rule 3).
objection: Wikivoyage calls it one of the world's most beautiful harbours.

name: Neiafu Pier
reason: Pier where youths jump: minor activity, not a distinct place to go (rule 3).
objection: Named in Wikivoyage Do list.

name: Vanilla Plantations of Utu Vava'u
reason: Diffuse countryside activity, not one place (rule 2, 3).
objection: Wikivoyage names it under See.

name: Beluga Diving
reason: Operator, not a place (COVERAGE: a spot is a place).
objection: Named by Tonga Tourism.

name: Kapa Island
reason: No counted source found on re-look; only guide-blog mentions (Swallows Cave sits on Kapa and is already covered).
objection: Snorkel stops there; a possible later candidate with a source.

name: Vaka'eitu Island
reason: No counted source found; only blog mentions as a camp and the Coral Gardens snorkel site.
objection: Coral Gardens (between Vaka'eitu and Nuapapu) may merit a separate candidate.
